text:
maria: hey all, quick q — where should I post my completed onboarding checklist so People Ops can sign me off? also how do I opt into release notifications and the CI bot? :wave:

noah: @maria welcome! Post the checklist in #new-hires and ping @julie (People Ops). theres a short form linked in the handbook: https://handbook.redwood/inboarding/checklist (one-liner answers ok)

ali: for release/ci alerts — join #release-notifs and run `@releases subscribe` in that channel. CI alerts are opt-in: DM `@ci-bot subscribe team=<your-team>` and it will confirm.

devops-bot: System: To invite a bot to a channel, use `/invite @ci-bot` from within the channel. If you don't see a bot in the autocomplete, ping infra to enable it.

julie: @maria added — once you post the checklist Ill confirm and mark you as onboarded. I can also set up the 30/60/90 check-ins if you want. FYI we prefer short thread replies for checklist follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

maria: got it, thanks! two tiny follow-ups — 1) should I post laptop/hardware pickup questions in #lunch-plans or somewhere else? 2) any quick channel etiquette pointers (threads vs dms) so I don't accidentally spam eng channels?

noah: 1) Hardware questions -> #people-ops-hardware or DM @it-support. 2) Threads for content-related follow-ups, DMs for 1:1s or secrets (credentials), and use reactions instead of "thanks" when possible. If an actual outage, ping #eng-oncall and @oncall.

ali: also, to reduce noise you can mute bot messages per-channel: channel -> Integrations -> find bot -> mute. if a bot supports filters, ask infra to set it to only alert specific teams.

maria: thats super helpful — thanks all. posting checklist now. :tada:

onboard-bot: Thanks @maria — checklist received. People Ops will review and reply here within 24 hours. If anything is missing well DM you.
